name: Riverside Cottage
tagline: Wake up to the sound of the river
shortDescription: A two-room stone cottage right at the edge of the Bandal stream, ten minutes' walk from the village market.
description: Riverside Cottage sits where the hillside levels out beside the stream, so it's the cooler of our two properties even in May and June. Both rooms open onto a shared veranda facing the water.
Meals are cooked in the main house and brought over, or you're welcome to eat with the family — most guests end up doing the second after the first night.

rooms.name: Garden Room
rooms.notes: Attached bath, faces the kitchen garden

location.address: Bandal Stream Road, 6 km above Mussoorie Road, Dehradun
location.directionsNote: Reachable by car up to the property gate. The last 400m from the main road is a single-lane track — we'll send a pin on WhatsApp once you book.

reviews.text: Fell asleep to the stream every night. The family cooked us dinner on two of the three nights and it was the best meal of the trip.
Quieter and cooler than where we stayed in Mussoorie town. Would go back just for the veranda.
Lovely stay, basic but exactly as described. Wifi was patchy in the room but fine on the veranda.

name: Ridge House
tagline: The valley view that doesn't end
shortDescription: A three-room house at the top of the ridge with an open view across the whole valley, best for sunrise and sunset.
description: Ridge House is a five-minute uphill walk from Riverside Cottage, and worth every step of it — the terrace looks straight down the valley with nothing in the way. It's the warmer of our two spots in winter since it gets the morning sun first.
This is the property to pick if you want to actually sit still for a few days. There's a hammock, a long terrace table, and not much else to do but watch the light change.

rooms.name: Valley View Room
rooms.notes: Attached bath, private terrace access, best sunrise view

rooms.name: Twin Room
rooms.notes: Attached bath, shares the main terrace

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.notes: Attached bath, two connecting beds, valley view

location.address: Top of Birchwood Ridge, 6.5 km above Mussoorie Road, Dehradun
location.directionsNote: Cars can park at Riverside Cottage; it's a five-minute walk up a stone path from there. We carry luggage up for you.

reviews.text: Sat on that terrace for three days straight and don't regret a minute of it. The sunrise from the Valley View Room is unreal.
Booked the Family Room with our two kids, plenty of space, and the kids loved helping feed the chickens in the morning.
